{{Quote|Well...that bully has been scaring away my customers and making a mess. He really needs to be taught a lesson.<br />I'll see what I can do.<br />Thank you so much! I don't like the way he looks at me.|[[Tiarsis]] and a spacer|<ref name="SWG:T" />}}
'''Ryzer''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:T" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he frequented the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]. Considered a bully, the cantina owner [[Tiarsis]] asked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for [[Rydel Delan]], Tansarii Point's brawling master, to help her intimidate the man, as he was scaring away customers and making her feel uncomfortable. While doing so, the spacer discovered that a group of renegades calling themselves the [[Genesis Red (gang)|Genesis Red]] was planning to sabotage the station.<ref name="SWG:T" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ryzer was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:T" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Ryzer was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|New Player Tutorial]]," introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> In the game, his name was only seen as "Cantina Bully."<ref name="SWG:T" /> However, the game's creature database appeared to give him the full designation as "Ryzer (Cantina Bully)."<ref name="TRE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|directory tree files}}</ref>
